title: What Actually Sets the Two Formats Apart

content.text: Crown Casino Australia runs as one of the country's largest hospitality employers overall. The online side partners with over 200 game studios to build a catalogue that would be physically impossible to fit onto any casino floor.

items: **Physical scale and atmosphere**: the resorts combine gaming with hotels, theatres and dozens of restaurants, creating a full destination rather than just a place to play.

**Currency and payment style on-site**: parking, chips and in-venue spending across the resorts increasingly run cashless, with wallet systems tied to a physical Rewards card rather than loose cash changing hands.
**Welcome bonus online**: new players joining Crown Casino online get a four-deposit match package worth up to AU$800 plus free spins, a perk with no real equivalent on the physical gaming floor.
